title: TraceEvent
description: One runtime event, attributed to an AST node by span. Records the branch actually taken and the iteration actually run, which no surveyed system does.

iteration.description: Loop ordinal. PROV has no loop counter, so it is carried here.

taken.description: On a branch event: whether control entered the body. Nothing in the surveyed prior art records this, so it is the module's acceptance criterion rather than a by-product.

callee.description: On a c_call or c_return event: the fully qualified name of the C callee, which settrace cannot see and setprofile can. The same string awl.ids mints an identity from.

index.description: Position in the event sequence: the query surface for order.

locals.description: Variable state at this event. Typed members serialize as typed nodes, not repr().
